description: Add a meal to the user's food diary: one or more food items, each with an optional quantity and macros, plus an optional meal label, date, note and provenance `source`. The reply names the new entry's `id` and `local_date`, which identify it for a later edit or deletion. When the user names one of their saved recipes ("my chicken and rice", "half my chili"), send their words as one item's name, with any amount in quantity; Forkmate logs the recipe's own foods and numbers in its place. All calorie and macro values, including carbohydrates, are estimates from USDA FoodData Central, Open Food Facts, the user's own entry or an AI assistant's estimate — approximate, not lab-measured or specific to a package or batch, and not suitable for insulin dosing (including carb counting for a meal bolus), blood-glucose prediction or any other medical decision.

at.description: ISO-8601 instant the meal was eaten; defaults to now.

items.description: The foods in this meal, one entry per food.

barcode.description: The package's UPC/EAN barcode, when the food came from a barcode lookup.

caffeine_mg.description: Optional caffeine content of this item, in milligrams (e.g. ~95 for a mug of brewed coffee).

fluid_ml.description: Optional fluid/hydration volume of this item, in millilitres (e.g. 240 for an 8 oz cup).

macros.description: Estimated nutrition for the portion eaten. Omitted fields are looked up from the food databases.

carb_g.description: Total carbohydrate for the whole portion eaten, in grams.

fat_g.description: Total fat for the whole portion eaten, in grams.

kcal.description: Energy for the whole portion eaten, in kilocalories (not per 100 g).

protein_g.description: Protein for the whole portion eaten, in grams.

name.description: What the food is, e.g. 'scrambled eggs' or 'Greek yogurt, plain'.

quantity.description: Portion as a display label, e.g. '3', '1 cup' or '2 × 1 frank (96 g)'. Display only: the server stores macros exactly as sent and does not re-scale them.

local_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD diary date; defaults to the user's local date (from their timezone).

meal.description: Which meal of the day this was.

note.description: Optional free-text note stored with the meal, e.g. 'post-run'.

source.description: Optional provenance for these items: the `source` label of the food-database candidate they came from ('USDA', 'Open Food Facts', 'Forkmate' or 'product label'), or 'estimate'. Defaults to 'estimate'; unrecognized values are recorded as an estimate.

name: log_meal

totals.description: Calories and macros. Estimates, not lab-measured; not for insulin dosing.

entry.description: One diary entry: a meal with its foods.

at.description: ISO-8601 UTC instant the food was eaten.

id.description: Identifies the entry for a later edit or deletion.

macros.description: Calories and macros. Estimates, not lab-measured; not for insulin dosing.

unknown_macros.description: Macros missing from the source data: shown as 0 but unknown, not a real zero.

meal.description: breakfast, lunch, dinner or snack, when set.
